newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen edging upwards, focus on stocks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen edging upwards, focus on stocks.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: DRAINAGE OF 200 BLN YEN
*Key September 10-year JGB futures expected to edge upwards on Monday, supported by a tight supply/demand balance and positive technical charts, traders said.
*Tokyo share prices the primary focus, a trader for a city bank's securities unit said. If share prices continue to fall, JGBs will test upside, he said.
